=== aloma --help
Usage: aloma [options] [command]

CLI for interacting with Aloma services and utilities

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  auth|login                   Authenticate with Aloma via browser and store
                               session token
  logout                       Clear the stored Aloma session token
  workspace                    Manage Aloma workspaces
  company                      Manage Aloma companies
  step                         Manage steps
  library                      Manage automation libraries
  task                         Manage tasks
  webhook                      Manage webhooks
  secret                       Manage secrets
  connector                    Manage connectors
  user                         Manage users
  deploy [options] <yamlPath>  Deploy resources from a YAML configuration file
  setup [options]              Setup Aloma CLI configuration
  help [command]               display help for command
=== aloma auth --help
Usage: aloma auth|login [options]

Authenticate with Aloma via browser and store session token

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
=== aloma logout --help
Usage: aloma logout [options]

Clear the stored Aloma session token

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
=== aloma workspace --help
Usage: aloma workspace [options] [command]

Manage Aloma workspaces

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                 List all automation workspaces
  show [options]                 Show current workspace
  switch [identifier]            Switch to a different workspace by name or ID
  add [options] <name>           Create a new workspace
  delete [options] [workspace]   Delete a workspace or cancel deletion
  archive [options] [workspace]  Archive or unarchive a workspace
  update [options] [workspace]   Update workspace settings
  source [options]               Edit the source configuration for the
                                 workspace
  sync [options]                 Trigger source sync for the workspace
  help [command]                 display help for command
=== aloma workspace list --help
Usage: aloma workspace list [options]

List all automation workspaces

Options:
  -f, --filter-name <name>  Filter workspaces by name
  -t, --tags <tags>         Comma-separated list of tags for the workspace
  -a --archived             Show archived workspaces
  -h, --help                display help for command
=== aloma workspace show --help
Usage: aloma workspace show [options]

Show current workspace

Options:
  -s, --stats           Show workspace stats
  -sc, --source         Show source config
  -w, --workspace <id>  Workspace ID
  --workspace-id <id>   Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help            display help for command
=== aloma workspace switch --help
Usage: aloma workspace switch [options] [identifier]

Switch to a different workspace by name or ID

Arguments:
  identifier  Workspace name or ID (optional - will show interactive selection
              if not provided)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
=== aloma workspace add --help
Usage: aloma workspace add [options] <name>

Create a new workspace

Arguments:
  name               Workspace name

Options:
  -t, --tags <tags>  Comma-separated list of tags for the workspace
  -h, --help         display help for command
=== aloma workspace delete --help
Usage: aloma workspace delete [options] [workspace]

Delete a workspace or cancel deletion

Arguments:
  workspace            Workspace ID or name (uses current if not specified)

Options:
  -c, --cancel         Cancel workspace deletion
  -d, --days <days>    Days until permanent deletion (default: "30")
  --workspace-id <id>  Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help           display help for command
=== aloma workspace archive --help
Usage: aloma workspace archive [options] [workspace]

Archive or unarchive a workspace

Arguments:
  workspace            Workspace ID or name (uses current if not specified)

Options:
  -u, --unarchive      Unarchive workspace
  --workspace-id <id>  Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help           display help for command
=== aloma workspace update --help
Usage: aloma workspace update [options] [workspace]

Update workspace settings

Arguments:
  workspace                           Workspace ID or name (uses current if not
                                      specified)

Options:
  -n, --name <name>                   New workspace name
  -t, --tags <tags>                   Comma-separated list of tags
  -h, --health-enabled <boolean>      Enable/disable health checks (true/false)
  -g, --notification-groups <groups>  Comma-separated list of notification
                                      groups
  --workspace-id <id>                 Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  --help                              display help for command
=== aloma workspace source --help
Usage: aloma workspace source [options]

Edit the source configuration for the workspace

Options:
  -w, --workspace <id>                   Workspace ID
  -f, --file <path>                      Path to source config JSON file
  --url <url>                            Source URL
  --username <username>                  Source username
  --apikey <apikey>                      Source API key
  --branch <branch>                      Source branch
  --enabled <enabled>                    Source enabled (true/false)
  --source-automatic <source_automatic>  Source automatic (true/false)
  --workspace-id <id>                    Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help                             display help for command
=== aloma workspace sync --help

  -h, --help            display help for command

  edit [options] <id>    Edit a step
  clone [options] <id>   Clone a step
  pull [options]         Pull steps from workspace to local files
  sync [options]         Sync local step files to workspace
  generate [options]     Generate a step interactively using AI
  help [command]         display help for command

  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: aloma step pull [options]

Pull steps from workspace to local files

Options:
  -w, --workspace <id>  Workspace ID
  -s, --step <id>       Step ID or name (if not specified, pulls all steps)
  -p, --path <path>     Target path (default: current directory)
  --workspace-id <id>   Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help            display help for command
=== aloma step sync --help

Sync local step files to workspace

Options:
  -w, --workspace <id>  Workspace ID
  -s, --step <id>       Step ID or name (if not specified, syncs all steps)
  -p, --path <path>     Source path (default: current directory)
  --workspace-id <id>   Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help            display help for command

=== aloma task --help
Usage: aloma task [options] [command]

Manage tasks

Options:
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]        List all tasks
  log [options] <id>    Log task details
  new [options] <name>  Create a new task
  clone [options] <id>  Clone a task
  stop <id>             Stop a task
  resume <id>           Resume a task
  help [command]        display help for command
=== aloma task list --help
Usage: aloma task list [options]

List all tasks

Options:
  -w, --workspace <id>  Workspace ID
  -s, --state <state>   Filter by state (null, done, attention, error, ignored)
  -n, --name <name>     Filter by task name
  -p, --page <page>     Page number
  --workspace-id <id>   Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help            display help for command
=== aloma task log --help
Usage: aloma task log [options] <id>

Log task details

Arguments:
  id               Task ID

Options:
  --logs           Show console and audit logs for each step
  --changes        Show diff changes for each step
  --inspect        Show task data after each step
  --step <number>  Show logs/changes for a specific step number
  -h, --help       display help for command
=== aloma task new --help
Usage: aloma task new [options] <name>

Create a new task

Arguments:
  name                  Task name

Options:
  -w, --workspace <id>  Workspace ID
  -d, --data <json>     JSON data to send with the task (e.g. '{"test":true}')
  -f, --file <path>     Path to YAML file containing task data
  --workspace-id <id>   Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help            display help for command

Usage: aloma secret [options] [command]

Manage secrets

Options:

  help [command]                display help for command
=== aloma secret list --help

List all secrets (values are hidden unless --reveal is given)

  --reveal              Show the values of non-encrypted secrets
  --workspace-id <id>   Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help            display help for command

  name                             Secret name
  value                            Secret value

Options:
  -w, --workspace <id>             Workspace ID
  -d, --description <description>  Secret description
  -e, --encrypted                  Mark secret as encrypted
  -o, --options <yaml>             YAML options for the secret
  --workspace-id <id>              Workspace ID (no name lookup)
  -h, --help                       display help for command
